title: Beyond the buzz: Grounding interoceptive interventions in mechanisms of brain–body coupling
content:
by Daniel S. Kluger, Teresa Berther, Martina Saltafossi, Jana Fehring, Joachim Gross

The field of interoception research is growing at a rapid pace. We need to establish mechanistic insight into brain–body interactions and validate readouts before we can develop effective body-based health interventions. The field of interoception research is growing at a rapid pace. This Perspective highlights why establishing both mechanistic insight and construct validity will be critical prerequisites for developing effective body-based health interventions.
author: Daniel S. Kluger
